comment: Differences of one measure on one page, reviewed and accepted within exactly the reviewed range (scripts/ci-regression.py, Reviewed; docs/compat-evaluation.md). Every other measure, page, input and environment is gated as before.

differences.measure: compat-attribute r300: 300 dpi renders box-downsampled to the 72 dpi grid, mean absolute luma difference kasane–Poppler (open page: growth past OPEN_MAD_GROWTH)
differences.reason: Dense TilingType 1 patterns, now drawn from the periodic texture at their exact spacing and line coverage (as MuPDF). Poppler draws a pattern whose /BBox equals its step from a tile bitmap of whole device pixels — TilingType 1's constant spacing (ISO 32000, tiling pattern dictionary: cells a multiple of a device pixel apart) — so its cells drift from their exact position by a fraction of a pixel per step; kasane does not adjust the spacing (a documented deviation from TilingType 1, docs/limitations.md; MuPDF does not either). Line positions checked at 300 dpi: kasane's and MuPDF's at the exact spacing in both patterns, none missing. Equivalence check in the same Poppler and MuPDF versions: the same geometry drawn without a pattern — Poppler's pattern render differs from its own render of it by mad 16.58; kasane's head is 6.40 from it (941c47c: 6.48), 0.99 from MuPDF's (941c47c: 2.82); kasane drawing that geometry directly is 19.38 from Poppler's pattern render. MuPDF distance improves (8.33 -> 6.60); dpx_kp and every other measure stay gated.

differences.measure: compat runner content SSIM at 96 dpi against Poppler (8x8 inked windows, drop past CONTENT_SSIM_DROP)
differences.reason: A tiling pattern whose /BBox exceeds its step, now drawn from the periodic texture instead of tile by tile: cell edges keep their anti-aliased coverage. Poppler snaps the filled rectangles of each tile to whole pixels (its stroke adjustment of single-rectangle fills). Equivalence check in the same Poppler and MuPDF versions: the same geometry drawn without a pattern — Poppler's pattern render scores 0.901 against its own render of it; kasane's head 0.987 (941c47c: 0.981), and 0.9996 against MuPDF's pattern render (941c47c: 0.997). Page SSIM and every other measure stay gated. Square positions checked at 96 dpi: the same squares at the same pixels in kasane, Poppler and MuPDF; the differences are edge coverage and Poppler's colour of the pattern.
